news.headline: Delcath Management Presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management presented to investors in Boston days after the Q2 beat-and-raise, reiterating the HEPZATO KIT commercial ramp and center-expansion story; Canaccord Genuity has maintained a Buy rating on the stock.

news.headline: Wall Street Raises Price Targets on Delcath After Q2 Beat
news.summary: Following the Q2 report, H.C. Wainwright lifted its target to $32 from $30, BTIG to $21 from $17, and Clear Street to $27 from $26, all reiterating Buy ratings on continued HEPZATO volume growth and margin strength.

news.headline: Delcath: Temporary Headwinds Are Fading While Larger Opportunities Approach
news.summary: A bullish deep-dive argues Q3 seasonality will be less pronounced than prior years and that the bigger long-term opportunity is expanding HEPZATO into larger cancer populations (breast, colorectal), though pivotal data isn't expected before late 2027/2028.

news.headline: Delcath Reports Q2 2026 Results, Raises Full-Year Guidance to $104-108M
news.summary: Total revenue rose to $29.1M ($27.1M from HEPZATO KIT) versus $24.2M a year earlier, with 90% gross margin and ~30% YoY HEPZATO volume growth; management raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $104-108M and reiterated the 2026 treatment-center expansion plan.

news.headline: Delcath Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted 17,000 RSUs to new employee hires as an inducement award, a routine filing that nonetheless signals continued headcount growth to support the commercial and clinical-trial expansion.

news.headline: First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 DELUMA Trial of HEPZATO in Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: Delcath dosed the first patient at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in its global Phase 2 DELUMA trial evaluating HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer, opening a second major pipeline indication beyond uveal melanoma.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly checkpoint against the raised FY2026 revenue guidance of $104-108M; will show whether H2 seasonality is as muted as bulls expect.

catalysts.label: Treatment-center network expansion to ~37 active sites
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for roughly six more REMS-certified HEPZATO center activations in H2 2026 (from 31 currently) as the 9-region commercial team scales, targeting ~40 centers longer-term.

catalysts.when: Ongoing enrollment; hepatic-PFS data expected ~2028, OS data ~2029
catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 breast cancer trial
catalysts.detail: First patient dosed July 2026 (IEO Milan); trial evaluates HEPZATO + SOC vs. SOC alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer across 20+ US/EU sites.

catalysts.when: Ongoing enrollment; readout timeline not yet disclosed
catalysts.label: Phase 2 colorectal cancer (mCRC) trial
catalysts.detail: Global trial (~90 patients, 20+ sites) evaluating HEPZATO combined with trifluridine-tipiracil/bevacizumab in third-line liver-dominant mCRC; represents a much larger addressable population than uveal melanoma.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 HCC / intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma program
catalysts.detail: Additional liver-cancer indications in the global Phase 2 program that could further broaden HEPZATO's label over time.

pulse: Delcath is riding a strong post-earnings wave: the August 6 Q2 beat-and-raise (revenue $29.1M, FY26 guidance lifted to $104-108M) triggered a cluster of price-target hikes from H.C. Wainwright, BTIG and Clear Street and a bullish Seeking Alpha thesis, with management reinforcing the story at the Canaccord Genuity conference on August 11. The near-term narrative remains execution on center expansion toward ~37 sites by year-end, while the bigger optionality (DELUMA breast cancer and colorectal Phase 2 trials, both newly dosing patients) won't read out until 2027-2029.
